Name: gamehail
Description: Ask your game assistant from a deck key: hold to talk, fire a preset question, or send the answer out over voice comms.
Author: Zedwil

Actions.Name: Hold to Ask
Actions.Tooltip: Hold the key and speak. Release to send the question. Pick in settings whether the answer stays private, includes a screenshot, or goes out to the squad.

Actions.Name: Preset Question
Actions.Tooltip: Send a question you typed in settings - no microphone involved.

Actions.Name: Mute Speech
Actions.Tooltip: Stop gamehail speaking, and start it again.

Actions.Name: Cancel
Actions.Tooltip: Cut the current answer short and hide the overlay.

Actions.Name: Status
Actions.Tooltip: Shows what gamehail is doing, and whether it is running at all.
